title: The Baptism of the Lord: First Luminous Mystery
summary: Pray the First Luminous Mystery page by page: the story of the Baptism of the Lord, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Piero della Francesca's painting of the Baptism: John pours water over Jesus as the dove descends.

pages.title: The Baptism of the Lord
pages.body: Jesus came to the Jordan River to be baptized by John. When he came up from the water, the heavens opened, the Holy Spirit came down like a dove, and the Father said: This is my beloved Son. As we pray this decade, we remember our own baptism and ask to stay close to God.
pages.alt: Piero della Francesca's painting of the Baptism: John pours water over Jesus as the dove descends.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 3 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And Jesus being baptized, forthwith came out of the water: and lo, the heavens were opened to him: and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him. And behold a voice from heaven, saying: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

(Matthew 3:13-17)

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Baptism of the Lord, the First Luminous Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Openness to the Holy Spirit
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of openness to the Holy Spirit. At baptism we became God's children. What does it mean to live as a beloved child of God today?

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, help us live every day as your Father's beloved children. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.
